body.statement: For a fixed positive optimization penalty \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}\) in the regular interior assignment problem of Fang, Ridder, and Xie, their Theorem 5 shows that the cross-fitted doubly robust optimizer has the efficient Gaussian limit and that its \(n\)-scaled penalized regret converges to the corresponding efficient Hessian quadratic form.

source.locator: Theorem 5 in arXiv:2512.19230v3, unnumbered displayed optimizer and penalized-regret limits

attestation.note: Verified against Theorem 5 in the version-3 arXiv HTML on 2026-09-14; the stable source handle is supplied in lieu of a long verbatim transcription.
